image_title: Quarterly Sector Performance and YoY Growth
summary: The table presents the quarterly performance of various sectors for the periods ending September 30, 2025, June 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024, along with year-over-year (YoY) growth in both reported and constant currency (CC) terms. Key sectors include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others. Financial Services consistently leads in percentage contribution across all quarters, while Manufacturing shows the highest YoY growth in reported terms at 9.3%. Life Sciences experienced a decline in YoY growth, with a reported decrease of 8.9%. The total percentage for each quarter sums to 100%, indicating a comprehensive sectoral distribution. The table highlights sectoral performance trends and growth comparisons over the specified periods.
